title: Practical guidance. Genuine support. Meaningful progress.
content:
ABOUT
        A personal approach to change.
      
      
        Get to know Brom Glidden and his approach to helping people navigate challenges in life, relationships, and work.
        
        
          Start the Conversation
          How I Work
        
      
    
  



  
    
    
    
  



  
    
      
        
          
          
        
      
    
    
      Founder, Life Coach, and Consultant
      Meet Brom Glidden
      
        I founded True Connections because I value helping people work through challenges that can feel difficult to untangle on their own. Sometimes that means making a decision or finding direction. Other times, it means learning how to have a hard conversation, changing a habit, or figuring out why the same problem keeps coming back.
        I hold a master’s degree in counseling and have more than 15 years of experience supporting people through change. Today, my work at True Connections is coaching and consulting, with a focus on personal goals, relationships, communication, and workplace challenges.
        My approach is warm, collaborative, and direct. I want you to feel comfortable being honest, including when you are unsure, frustrated, or having trouble following through. We can look at what is getting in the way without losing sight of your strengths or what is already working.
        You bring your experience, values, and goals. I bring questions, perspective, and structure to help you decide how you want to move forward.

      
      Start the Conversation
    
  



  
    
    
    
  



  My approach
  Clarity, consistency, and momentum.
  At True Connections, growth is not about perfection. It is about clarity, consistency, and momentum.
  Clients are supported in:
  
    Understanding what is really driving the problem
    Defining what success looks like
    Building a realistic plan
    Following through with structure and accountability
  


  How I work
  Warm, direct, and results-focused.

  
    i.Client-centered: Your values, goals, and context shape the process
    ii.Practical: Sessions lead to clear actions, not vague advice
    iii.Structured: You receive a roadmap with priorities and next steps
    iv.Supportive: You get honest feedback, encouragement, and accountability
  
  Whether you are navigating stress, leadership pressure, relationship strain, team conflict, or major life transitions, support is tailored to your goals and pace.


  What matters in our work
  What matters in our work.
  
    Genuine care
    Clear communication
    Integrity and professionalism
    Growth through action
    Respect for each client’s strengths and lived experience
  



  
    
    
    
  



  Who we work with
  True Connections works with:
  
    i.Individuals pursuing personal growth, clarity, and follow-through.
    ii.Couples strengthening communication and connection
    iii.Professionals developing confidence, leadership, and career direction
    iv.Teams and organizations improving communication, systems, and outcomes
  
  Services are available in person in Sandpoint, Idaho, and online.

  Common questions
  Coaching, consulting, scheduling, and what to expect.
  
    01What is the difference between coaching and consulting?+Coaching helps you build clarity, mindset, communication, and consistent follow-through through a structured growth process.Consulting provides expert analysis, strategy, and implementation support for specific personal or organizational goals and problems.
    02Do you provide therapy or clinical mental health treatment?+No. True Connections provides coaching and consulting services only. Services do not include therapy, diagnosis, or clinical treatment.
    03Who do you work with?+True Connections works with individuals, couples, leaders, professionals, teams, and small businesses.
    04What issues can coaching help with?+Common areas include life direction, confidence, mindset, emotional wellness, stress, resilience, relationships, communication, career growth, leadership growth, and work-life balance.
    05What issues can consulting help with?+Consulting supports strategy, management challenges, organizational development, change management, process improvement, workplace communication, leadership development, conflict resolution, and burnout resilience planning.
    06Do you offer online sessions?+Yes. Services are available both online and in person in Sandpoint, Idaho.
    07How long are sessions?+Typical session length is 60 minutes for individual coaching, 75 minutes for relationship coaching, and 60 minutes for consulting.
    08How often do sessions happen?+Most clients meet weekly or every other week, depending on goals, complexity, and preferred pace. Many clients start weekly for 4 to 6 sessions, then shift to biweekly.
    09How long do clients usually work with you?+Engagement length varies by need. Some clients choose a focused short-term plan, while others continue longer for deeper growth and accountability. Many clients work together for 1 to 3 months to build momentum, then adjust from there.
    10What happens during the first call?+The discovery call focuses on your goals, current challenges, and desired outcomes. You will discuss fit, recommended next steps, and whether coaching, consulting, or both is the best approach.

title: Move from stuck to clear, confident action.
content:
WELCOME
        Move from stuck to clear, confident action.
      
      
        Coaching and consulting for life, relationships, and work. Based in Sandpoint, Idaho, with sessions available in person and online.
        
        
          Start the Conversation
          Explore Coaching
        
      
    
  










  
    
      A note from Brom
      A practical, personal approach to change.
    
    
      You may already know something needs to change without knowing where to start. Maybe you are facing a difficult decision, having the same frustrating conversation, or struggling to follow through on something that matters to you. You do not need to have it all figured out before we talk.
      My role is to help you sort through what is happening, understand your options, and decide what comes next. I bring a master’s degree in counseling and more than 15 years of experience supporting people through personal, relationship, and professional challenges. At True Connections, I use that background in my work as a life coach and consultant.
      You can expect me to listen carefully, ask thoughtful questions, and be direct with you. Together, we will work toward changes that fit your life, with room to adjust when something is not working.

title: Client reflections on coaching and consulting.
content:
TESTIMONIALS
        Client experiences.
      
      
        Read what clients have shared about working with Brom on personal goals, relationships, careers, and business challenges.
        
        Start the Conversation
      
    
  



  
    
    
    
  



  Personal growth and life direction
  
    
      “
      I put off contacting Brom because I thought I needed a clearer idea of what I wanted help with. Mostly I knew I was unhappy with how my weeks were going. He gave me room to explain it badly and asked questions that helped me sort it out. I realized how much I was taking on because I felt obligated. I’ve started making room for things I actually want to do, including getting back to hiking on weekends.
      — Laura M.Life coaching client
    
    
      “
      What I appreciated most was being able to say, ‘I didn’t do any of what we talked about,’ and have an honest conversation about why. Brom was interested in what had gotten in the way. I was scheduling everything for the end of the day, when I was already exhausted. We worked out a simpler routine that fit the time and energy I actually had. I’m following through more often now, and a difficult week doesn’t mean I give up on the whole plan.
      — Daniel R.Life coaching client
    
  


  Career, leadership, and decision-making
  
    
      “
      In our project meeting, I asked for a revised draft by Thursday and then stopped talking. No apology, no long explanation. That’s a real change for me. Working with Brom has made me more comfortable being direct with my team.
      — Megan T.Leadership coaching client
    
    
      “
      I kept asking other people whether I should take a new job, and every conversation left me with a different answer. Talking with Brom helped me think through what the longer commute would mean for my week and my time with my kids. I decided to stay where I was. I understood what I was giving up, and I felt comfortable with my reasons.
      — Brian K.Career coaching client
    
  


  Relationships and communication
  
    
      “
      I finally told my sister I needed help organizing our family gatherings. Brom and I had practiced how to bring it up, so I could ask without unloading years of frustration on her. She took over the food for the next one. I enjoyed being there a lot more when I wasn’t trying to do everything.
      — Julie H.Relationship coaching client
    
    
      “
      I was worried our sessions would turn into another argument, just with someone watching. Brom made sure we both had a chance to explain ourselves, and I felt like he understood each of us. Money was our biggest sticking point. We can sit down with the bills now and work out a plan without spending the whole evening upset with each other. That has been a relief.
      — Matt S.Relationship coaching client
    
  



  
    
    
    
  



  Consulting and team support
  
    
      “
      I booked a session because too many things were competing for my attention in the business. Brom helped me put customer follow-up first. We worked out who would handle new inquiries and how we’d keep track of them. I took the plan back to my team, and we started using it the following Monday.
      — Ryan W.Business consulting client
    
    
      “
      ‘We should look into that’ used to be how a lot of our meetings ended. Then we’d have the same conversation the following week because nobody knew whose job it was. Brom helped us talk about that without people feeling singled out. Now we finish meetings by writing down the decision, who’s responsible, and when we’ll check back. Months later, we’re still using that routine. We spend a lot less time trying to remember what everyone agreed to.
      — Susan B.Team consulting client

      Start the conversation.
      If you are looking for practical support, clearer direction, or help moving from reflection into action, the free discovery call is a simple place to start.
      Start the Conversation
